SELECT d.index_name AS name, COUNT(s.id) AS value FROM dictionary d LEFT JOIN shixi s ON s.shixi_types = d.code_index WHERE d.dic_code = 'shixi_types' GROUP BY d.code_index, d.index_name ORDER BY d.code_index

SELECT d.index_name AS name, COUNT(s.id) AS value FROM dictionary d LEFT JOIN shixi s ON s.shixi_jieguo_types = d.code_index WHERE d.dic_code = 'shixi_jieguo_types' GROUP BY d.code_index, d.index_name ORDER BY d.code_index
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%c') AS monthNum, COUNT(*) AS total FROM shixi WHERE create_time IS NOT NULL AND YEAR(create_time) = #{year} GROUP BY monthNum ORDER BY CAST(monthNum AS SIGNED)
SELECT YEAR(create_time) FROM shixi WHERE create_time IS NOT NULL ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT IFNULL(q.qiye_name, '未知企业') AS name, COUNT(z.id) AS value FROM zhaopin_gangwei z LEFT JOIN qiye q ON z.qiye_id = q.id WHERE q.qiye_name IS NOT NULL AND q.qiye_name != '' GROUP BY q.qiye_name ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT IFNULL(x.xuesheng_name, '') AS studentName, IFNULL(x.xuesheng_xuehao, '') AS studentNumber, IFNULL(x.xuesheng_photo, '') AS studentPhoto, IFNULL(q.qiye_name, '') AS companyName, IFNULL(s.shixi_gangwei_name, '') AS positionName, DATE_FORMAT(s.shixi_kaishi_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS startDate, CASE WHEN s.shixi_kaishi_time IS NOT NULL AND s.shixi_kaishi_time > CURDATE() THEN '未开始' WHEN s.shixi_jieshu_time IS NOT NULL AND s.shixi_jieshu_time < CURDATE() THEN '已结束' ELSE '进行中' END AS status FROM shixi s LEFT JOIN xuesheng x ON s.xuesheng_id = x.id LEFT JOIN qiye q ON s.qiye_id = q.id ORDER BY s.create_time DESC, s.id DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT IFNULL(q.qiye_name, '') AS companyName, IFNULL(z.zhaopin_gangwei_name, '') AS positionName, IFNULL(z.zhaopin_leixing, '') AS positionType, IFNULL(z.xinzi_fanwei, '') AS salaryRange, IFNULL(z.gongzuo_dizhi, '') AS workAddress, z.yizhao_renshu AS hiredCount, z.zhaopin_renshu AS recruitCount, DATE_FORMAT(z.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS publishDate FROM zhaopin_gangwei z LEFT JOIN qiye q ON z.qiye_id = q.id ORDER BY z.create_time DESC, z.id DESC LIMIT 5
